posts.text:
I joined the Juneteenth celebration in Rondo to celebrate the end of slavery and honor a neighborhood whose history reflects both the challenges we've faced and the progress we've made.

With voting rights still under attack it is a reminder that the fight for justice never ends.

posts.text:
161 years ago, enslaved Black Americans in Galveston, Texas learned they were free.

Juneteenth reminds us of both the promise of freedom and the responsibility to build a more just nation.

Today we celebrate that while recognizing that freedom is still a work in progress.

AI can clone anyone's likeness now — yours or even your child’s.

Today in the Senate Judiciary Committee we passed the NO FAKES Act — bipartisan legislation I lead with Chris Coons, Marsha Blackburn and Thom Tillis — to protect people from having their voice and likeness replicated without their permission.

posts.text:
Reliable broadband is essential for Minnesota families, farmers, students, and small businesses.

Building on my work leading the legislation to bring federal broadband funding to MN, my Last Mile Initiative will connect the 120,000 households that still lack access to high-speed internet and finish the job of bringing broadband to every corner of our state.
